race.comment: ASTRODEAN (1) raced on the speed last start and battled on well but found one better over 1430m at Naracoorte. Has been in solid form this campaign with a win and three minor placings from seven starts and looks a leading contender again. DAZELLES (4) went forward last start over 1200m at Strathalbyn and held on well for second, beaten 2 lengths. Knocking on the door and will take catching. CASINO SHOWGIRL (3) returns from a spell of five months and is having her first run for the Day yard (ex Will Clarken). Still lightly raced and looks well placed. MELISSA KATE (7) was beaten 3.5 lengths into fourth over 1200m at Mt Gambier at her latest appearance. She doesn't win many but can sneak a placing.
